fieldValues.title: Saving a recovery copy freezes the writer's cursor
fieldValues.statement: In the web editor, keeping a recovery copy of the document in the browser means serialising the whole repository on the main thread, so a writer working in a large repository (the muSrs essay, about 900 instances) sees the cursor stick for a moment every few seconds. The pause is short, but it recurs and breaks writing flow, and it grows with the repository. Quieting the schedule (srs-web#769) moves the pause out of the typing, but the whole-repo export still blocks whenever it runs, so any large repository, or a long burst of agent writes, brings it back.
